name: agent-config
description: Claude Code mods that ship with agent-config

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: /ledger prints each task ledger's goal, current step and next step; /ledger:task, /ledger:update, /ledger:next, /ledger:close and /ledger:go start, write and switch tasks; /ledger:worktrees prints each linked git worktree; /ledger:retire archives a task's ledger and removes its worktree; /ledger:help lists every command
